title: Canonical cocone of limit etale section comparisons
statement: For the data of [def-weil-pbc-affine-section-diagram], define a cocone on E. Its point is (c.π(i₀)^*G)(W₀ × D c.pt), and its leg at op j is the section comparison [def-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison] for the cone triangle c.pt → D(j.left) → D(i₀). Cone naturality and the cone compatibility clause of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-section-comparison-laws] prove its naturality. No limit or affine hypothesis is needed for this construction.

proof.text: Construct the point and legs using the canonical cone comparisons; the cone compatibility clause of the comparison laws supplies naturality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 0EYL; Sites Tag 09YN; concrete functor and cocone formulation by M3. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YN and /tag/0EYL.
